profile_text.body:
Genpact LTD is listed as a for-profit public company headquartered in Hamilton, D0, with the ticker G and SEC CIK 0001398659. No AI products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it.

The website associated with the company is generali.com, which is the corporate site of Assicurazioni Generali Group. That site describes itself as offering storytelling on topics of general interest along with information about its activities, financial data, news, CSR, career opportunities, and history. It also refers to a plan called "Lifetime Partner 27: Driving Excellence," which the group says will further enhance excellence across its customer relationships, its group operating model, and its core capabilities.

The name Genpact LTD and the content of the linked site, which describes an insurance group, do not match. Nothing in the available material describes Genpact LTD's own business or any AI offerings.
